**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mr Moor](../persons.html#1046)
Many thanks for being so kind as to send me [your book](../others.html#124). I am glad it has prospered enough to come to another edition-
I think that the notice of [Mr Wither](../persons.html#1544)’s birth was as it stood in the Hants’ paper I suppose it came from the roll at Winchester though I certainly thought he would have been 90 in November -
I am glad your German expedition was fairly satisfactory

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd/ J F Moor/ Glencairn/ Chiselhurst.

Postmarked Winchester My 5/99.
